name: Doraemon: 16 Directions, One Mouse to Avoid

localized_names.en: Doraemon: 16 Directions, One Mouse to Avoid
localized_names.zh: 哆啦A梦：16个方向到处看看

author: 洪铭 万.
variant_note: Independently AI-assisted 2D manga fan-art variant, already published as Petdex doraemon-4. Distinct artwork from the existing xueshi package. Its idle gaze is baked into a pre-shuffled looping animated WebP with 20 atlas frames; the running row tells a six-panel pocket, bamboo-copter and dorayaki story. This does not implement live mouse tracking.
description: A classic flat 2D manga Doraemon pet with a shuffled 16-direction idle gaze, pocket surprises, a bamboo-copter and dorayaki, plus nine animation states.
